boundary: All dimensions are provisional design targets for option comparison. They are not surveyed conditions, statutory controls, construction dimensions, quantities, prices, permits or commitments. Replace them after official geometry, ownership, utilities, access and professional review are available.

recalculation_triggers: road, rail, fire, drainage and utility review

stations.role_en: Keep risk inside a bypassable and clearable test pocket

plan_modules.name_zh: 连续普通步行与无障碍主链
离线状态与人工求助点
plan_modules.name_en: offline status and staffed help point

plan_modules.name_zh: 树荫休息与公园返回带

frontage_states.BASE: Park edge, ordinary route, passive status and staffed help remain open.
frontage_states.TEST_WINDOW: A bounded pocket opens behind a visible buffer and staffed takeover point.
frontage_states.BLACKOUT: Digital and autonomous functions stop; the pocket is isolated and the ordinary route remains.
frontage_states.CLOSEOUT: Temporary assets leave, surfaces and planting are checked, and the ordinary park edge is restored.

flows.ordinary: arrival -> status -> accessible stitch -> shaded rest -> park return
flows.test: booked entry -> visible boundary -> supervised test -> stop bay -> signed exit
flows.maintenance: service edge -> asset check -> isolated repair -> reinstatement receipt
flows.emergency: ordinary route kept clear; test pocket closes before emergency access is reduced

capacity_check.formula: release_capacity = min(usable_area / reviewed_density, egress_capacity, staffed_supervision_cap, noise_and_access_cap)

responsibility_archetypes.maintenance_owner: park asset and landscape maintenance team
responsibility_archetypes.independent_acceptance: accessibility, traffic, fire and public-interest reviewers

cost_envelope_cny.method: quantity survey by reversible component, staffing window, maintenance cycle and reinstatement liability

service_level_targets.target: critical route obstruction triggers immediate stop and isolation within 15 minutes
public state board updates within 15 minutes of a stop decision
ordinary route and surface condition receive a signed closeout check before reopening

delivery.acceptance_gate: No test window until river, flood, traffic, ownership, fire, accessibility, staffing, maintenance and reinstatement responsibilities are confirmed.
delivery.rollback: Stop, isolate the pocket, keep the ordinary route open, remove temporary equipment and issue a reinstatement receipt.

stations.role_zh: 把来源、贡献、撤回与人工服务留在同一条街上
stations.role_en: Keep provenance, contribution, withdrawal and staffed service on one street

plan_modules.name_zh: 连续普通步行与安静返回链
住宅安静边与不消费停留
plan_modules.name_en: residential quiet edge and non-commercial stay

frontage_states.BASE: Ordinary service, quiet edge, paper directory and rights contact remain visible.
frontage_states.TEST_WINDOW: A reviewed contribution is shown for a declared period with staffed correction and withdrawal.
frontage_states.BLACKOUT: Screens and automated retrieval stop; paper, staff and quiet-return route remain.
frontage_states.CLOSEOUT: The contribution is archived, corrected or removed and the frontage returns to ordinary learning and service.

flows.ordinary: campus edge -> staffed service -> paper directory -> quiet seat -> residential return
flows.contribution: rights desk -> provenance check -> bounded display -> correction/withdrawal -> archive
flows.maintenance: service access -> content and fixing check -> isolated repair -> public correction log
flows.emergency: release room closes while the ordinary route and egress remain independent

capacity_check.formula: release_capacity = min(usable_area / reviewed_density, egress_capacity, staffed_service_cap, quiet_edge_cap)

ownership_interfaces.owner_archetype: rights holder, curator and archive steward

responsibility_archetypes.accountable_decision: public service and culture review lead
responsibility_archetypes.independent_acceptance: accessibility, heritage, residential-impact and public-interest reviewers

cost_envelope_cny.method: quantity survey by frontage adaptation, staffed service hours, rights review, archive, maintenance and reinstatement

service_level_targets.target: a rights dispute hides the affected content immediately while offline contact remains
correction or withdrawal receives acknowledgment within one working day and a status within five working days
invalid material is removed or replaced within 48 hours after confirmation

delivery.acceptance_gate: No fit-out or release until campus/parcel access, heritage, displacement risk, egress, accessibility, rights, staffing and withdrawal responsibilities are confirmed.
delivery.rollback: Hide disputed content, close the release room, preserve paper and staffed service, remove temporary display elements and publish a correction/withdrawal receipt.

stations.role_zh: 让活动容量能够降到零，居民归家路线仍然成立
stations.role_en: Let event capacity fall to zero while the resident return route remains

plan_modules.name_zh: 轨道至普通商业连续归家链
安静等候与照护停留湾

frontage_states.BASE: Rail arrival, crossing, quiet seat, ordinary retail and resident return remain open.
frontage_states.TEST_WINDOW: A bounded short event opens with a public capacity state and staffed quiet route.
frontage_states.BLACKOUT: Event capacity drops to zero; displays stop and the resident route remains.
frontage_states.CLOSEOUT: Temporary assets and waste leave, defects are logged and the frontage returns to daily retail.

flows.ordinary: rail arrival -> crossing -> quiet seat -> ordinary retail -> resident return
flows.event: checked entry -> short display -> staffed route -> timed exit -> public closeout
flows.maintenance: service edge -> waste and asset removal -> defect check -> daily-use release
flows.emergency: event capacity falls to zero before rail, fire or resident access is reduced

capacity_check.formula: release_capacity = min(usable_area / reviewed_density, rail_and_crossing_cap, fire_egress_cap, quiet_route_cap, staffed_control_cap)

responsibility_archetypes.design_lead: station-area urban design and event-service team
responsibility_archetypes.maintenance_owner: public-realm, retail and cleaning asset teams
responsibility_archetypes.independent_acceptance: rail, traffic, fire, accessibility, noise and resident-access reviewers

cost_envelope_cny.method: quantity survey by temporary frontage, crowd control, staffing, cleaning, quiet-route protection and reinstatement

service_level_targets.target: a fire, crowd, water, noise or resident-access breach reduces event capacity to zero immediately
ordinary-use recovery receives a signed check within 30 minutes of planned event close
defects, complaints and unresolved impacts enter a public review within 14 days

delivery.acceptance_gate: No event window until rail, road, crossing, fire, crowd, weather, accessibility, quiet-route, cleaning and reinstatement responsibilities are confirmed.
delivery.rollback: Set capacity to zero, keep the resident route open, stop displays, clear temporary assets and publish the closeout and defect receipt.

shared_delivery_gates.gate: Every target dimension remains provisional and is recalculated after official geometry and survey.
Every station preserves a BASE route independent of account, model, network and power.
Capacity is formula-bound and remains null until egress, access, staffing and site inputs are reviewed.
Organization names, cost envelopes and procurement commitments remain unconfirmed until authorized.
Every TEST_WINDOW has a BLACKOUT and CLOSEOUT path with a public receipt.
A retained element enters statutory design, funding, approval and procurement separately.
